    # Find the rectangular panel outlined by a solid-color border.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # Find the large rectangular framed panel: full-color horizontal borders,
    # then remove the border row and side columns.
    full=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(r)>0 and len(set(r))==1]
    top=full[0]; bottom=full[-1]
    color=grid[top][0]
    left=next(j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[top+1][j]!=color)
    right=len(grid[0])-1-next(j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[top+1][::-1][j]!=color)
    return [r[left:right+1] for r in grid[top+1:bottom]]"}

foils.nl: Extract the rectangle strictly enclosed by the color-2 border, removing the border itself.
foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==2 for x in r)]
    top,bottom=rs[0],rs[-1]
    left=next(j for j,x in enumerate(grid[top+1]) if x!=2)
    right=len(grid[top+1])-1-next(j for j,x in enumerate(grid[top+1][::-1]) if x!=2)
    return [r[left:right+1] for r in grid[top+1:bottom]]
